The single GTK window the Linux port runs in: a menu bar above the SDL drawing surface, in one top-level window.

Two Linux backends share this state. nativemenu fills the menu bar (built here, before the SDL window exists), and hostwindow embeds the SDL window beneath it and drives the window operations that on macOS go straight to SDL. filedialog and the panels read topWindow so their dialogs stand on this window.

The embedding is deliberate and its ordering matters - see the project memory note "linux-gtk-embed-approach": the SDL window is reparented into the drawing area while still unmapped and mapped by hand, because SDL_ShowWindow blocks once the window is a child, and GtkSocket will not map a window that does not speak XEMBED.
